text.text: The first settlement, from 2004, is fine-grained: small, separate buildings with generous open space between them, in a low pattern.
Solid and void, with fine and coarse grain shown in detail. Source: HDC; Google Maps.
The Hiyaa towers are coarse-grained: large, tall blocks set close together, with open space laid out around them. They mark Hulhumalé’s shift to compact, high-rise living.
